title: Add "Turn Off Screen" as an item in the Kicker model
line: Kicker, Kickoff and Application Dashboard now offer Turn Off Screen next to Lock, Log Out and Switch User.
explanation: Turning the screen off was only available as a Power Management keyboard shortcut; the launchers' system actions model had no entry for it, so Kicker, Kickoff and the dashboard couldn't offer it. This applies the open plasma-workspace!6469, which adds a Turn Off Screen entry to the kicker system actions model (Session group) that switches DPMS off through libkscreen's KScreen::Dpms and only shows when DPMS is supported.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: add Turn Off Screen to the system actions model

Turning the screen off was only reachable through a keyboard shortcut.
Add a Turn Off Screen entry to the session actions, shown when DPMS is
supported, so Kicker, Kickoff and the dashboard can offer it as well.

BUG: 509314
